definitions.explanation: A coiling, circular pattern or motion turning in toward a center, as in water swirling down a drain or a spiral shape.

examples.japanese: {煙|けむり}が{渦巻|うずま}きを{作|つく}った。
この{貝|かい}は{渦巻|うずま}きの{形|かたち}をしている。
examples.english: This shell has a spiral shape.

examples.japanese: {川|かわ}の{水|みず}が{岩|いわ}にぶつかって{渦巻|うずま}きを{作|つく}っていた。
examples.english: The river water hit the rocks and was forming whirlpools.

notes:
The noun form of {渦巻|うずま}く (to swirl, to eddy), formed from {渦|うず} (eddy) + {巻|ま}き (winding). Used for both physical swirls of water or smoke and spiral shapes or patterns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {渦巻|うずま}き{模様|もよう}: a spiral pattern
- {渦巻|うずま}き{状|じょう}: spiral-shaped; in a spiral
- {渦巻|うずま}きを{作|つく}る: form a swirl

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {渦|うず}: eddy; swirl — the shorter, more general word; {渦巻|うずま}き emphasizes the coiling, winding shape
